description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForms page managing the display and submission of a theory exam. It handles loading questions from the database, managing session-based user authentication, and saving user answers back to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page managing theory exam questions and submissions in an online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load, initializes questions from database and sets timer based on session data.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns a descriptive course name based on course ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of answers, stores responses in database, and updates relevant queues.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates countdown timer display and handles timeout.
